name: UnKeep
description: A private, self-hosted, Google Keep-style notes app with end-to-end encrypted sync. Notes are encrypted on your devices; this container only stores ciphertext. AI agents and scripts can use the same vault through the bundled unkeep CLI. HTTPS is required: on plain HTTP (including the WebUI button) you'll see an "UnKeep needs HTTPS" page. Use Tailscale Serve, a reverse proxy, or Cloudflare Tunnel. Set two different random tokens below (openssl rand -hex 32). On your first device, enter the setup token and save the recovery kit. Back up appdata before updating.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Encrypted vault database. No preparation needed. Back it up before updating.

ports.name: WebUI port
ports.description: Web app port (plain HTTP). Put HTTPS in front of it; don't expose it to the internet directly.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User the app runs as. It takes ownership of the data folder on start. Must not be 0.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group the app runs as. Must not be 0.

variables.name: Setup token
variables.description: Creates the vault on your first device. 32-256 characters, no spaces (openssl rand -hex 32).

variables.name: Recovery token
variables.description: Restores access with your recovery kit if you lose every device. Must differ from the setup token. Keep it safe.

variables.name: Link previews
variables.description: Set to 1 for Keep-style link previews. The server then sees previewed URLs and needs internet access.

variables.name: Allowed origin
variables.description: Only for a separately hosted web app: its exact origin, such as https://notes.example.com. Usually empty.

variables.name: Trust proxy
variables.description: Set to 1 only if your reverse proxy replaces X-Forwarded-For, so rate limits see real client addresses.

variables.name: Max attachment size
variables.description: Attachment limit in bytes, default 26214400 (25 MiB). Lower it to restrict uploads; the apps never send more than 25 MiB.
